[Intro: handclaps, walking bass, soft electric piano]

[Verse 1: falsetto group vocals, easy]
Quarter for the locker, key on a pin
Hot concrete and the smell of the wind

Everybody I knew was there

Ten feet tall and terrified
Whole pool looking, toes on the edge

Summer of the high dive
I think about it when I'm scared, I do

[Verse 2: falsetto, guitar answering]
Snack bar window, frozen lime
My brother counting, one more time
Mama waving from the shallow end
I'd give a lot to jump for her again

[Chorus: full soul groove, strings]

Ten feet tall and terrified

Then the sky, then the water, then my head

Climb, climb (don't look down)
Climb, climb (don't look down)
